### Group 2 — Sub-part (a): Inward Completed & Verified

All soft delete logic, SKU duplicate/reuse handling, child item joins, and HTTP endpoints for Inward were implemented and tested against the test database (`shreehkweb_snj2024_test`) on port 3500.

#### 1. Changes Applied in Sub-part 2(a)
- [`productHelper.js`](file:///d:/Kishan_Ghodasara_Project/shreeHKCompany/ShreeHK_BackEnd/productHelper.js):
  - In `getDetail`, `getDetailBySku`, and `getDetailTest`: Added `AND (p.deleted = 0 OR p.deleted IS NULL)`. Soft-deleted stones are never returned.
- [`services/stockMovementService.js`](file:///d:/Kishan_Ghodasara_Project/shreeHKCompany/ShreeHK_BackEnd/services/stockMovementService.js):
  - In `getInwardItems`: Added `WHERE inward_id = ? AND (deleted = 0 OR deleted IS NULL)` to exclude deleted child records.
- [`routes/inward/inwardRoutes.js`](file:///d:/Kishan_Ghodasara_Project/shreeHKCompany/ShreeHK_BackEnd/routes/inward/inwardRoutes.js):
  - Batch SKU pre-check (`/inward/checkExist`): Filtered `(p.deleted = 0 OR p.deleted IS NULL)` on `dai_product` and `(ii.deleted = 0 OR ii.deleted IS NULL)` on `dai_inward_item`. Soft-deleted stone numbers do not block new entry creation.
  - Transaction SKU check (`/inward/save`): Filtered `(deleted = 0 OR deleted IS NULL)` on current company stock, other company stock, and other company inward items.
  - In `GET /inward/` (by id): Filtered `(p.deleted = 0 OR p.deleted IS NULL)` in child stone query `pquery`.
  - In `POST /inward/update`: Added `AND (deleted = 0 OR deleted IS NULL)` on record lookup.
- [`routes/transaction/transactionStockService.js`](file:///d:/Kishan_Ghodasara_Project/shreeHKCompany/ShreeHK_BackEnd/routes/transaction/transactionStockService.js):
  - `loadProductsByInwardId` & `loadProductsByIds`: Added `AND (p.deleted = 0 OR p.deleted IS NULL)`.
  - `getInwardData`: Added `AND (deleted = 0 OR deleted IS NULL)`.
  - `inwardMemoToPurchase` & `toggleInwardType`: Added `AND (deleted = 0 OR deleted IS NULL)`.
  - `deleteInwardStock`: Soft-deletes `dai_inward_item` records in the same transaction as `dai_inward`, `dai_product`, `dai_product_value`, and `dai_history`.
- [`routes/transaction/transactionPrintService.js`](file:///d:/Kishan_Ghodasara_Project/shreeHKCompany/ShreeHK_BackEnd/routes/transaction/transactionPrintService.js):
  - `fetchInwardDoc`: Filtered `AND (o.deleted = 0 OR o.deleted IS NULL)` and `AND (p.deleted = 0 OR p.deleted IS NULL)` while preserving Rule B (`LEFT JOIN dai_party p` without party deleted filter).

---

```text
✓ PASS: POST /transaction/inward-stock/list (purchase) (Found 0 purchase records)
✓ PASS: GET /inward/?id=2 (active bill detail) (Invoice: 10001, Items: 0)
✓ PASS: POST /inward/checkExist on active SKU "HKD-TEST-049" (Detected as existing)
✓ PASS: POST /inward/save create test inward (SKU: REUSE-SKU-791694) (New Inward ID: 144)
✓ PASS: Verify dai_product created for SKU REUSE-SKU-791694 (Product ID: 85186)
✓ PASS: POST /inward/checkExist detects newly created SKU as existing before delete
✓ PASS: DELETE /transaction/inward-stock?deleteId=144 (Message: Inward record deleted and stock removed successfully)
✓ PASS: DB: dai_inward soft deleted (deleted=1, deleted_at, deleted_by=1)
✓ PASS: DB: dai_inward_item soft deleted (deleted=1)
✓ PASS: DB: dai_product soft deleted (deleted=1, deleted_at, deleted_by=1)
✓ PASS: DB: dai_product_value soft deleted (deleted=1)
✓ PASS: GET /inward/?id=144 returns not found after soft-delete
✓ PASS: POST /transaction/inward-stock/list excludes soft-deleted inward
✓ PASS: POST /inward/checkExist for soft-deleted SKU allows reuse ("No existing products found")
✓ PASS: POST /inward/save successfully reused soft-deleted SKU on new inward (New Inward ID: 145)
✓ PASS: Reused SKU has new active row in dai_product (New Product ID: 85187, old was: 85186)
✓ PASS: Regression: Stock total products match baseline (Current: 90, Baseline: 90)
✓ PASS: Regression: Stock total carats match baseline (Current: 89.662, Baseline: 89.662)
✓ PASS: Regression: Stock total pcs match baseline (Current: 98, Baseline: 98)
```

---

### Plan for Group 2 — Sub-part (b): Outward / Hold / GIA / Memo / Return

#### 1. Files & Changes
- [`routes/outward/outwardRoutes.js`](file:///d:/Kishan_Ghodasara_Project/shreeHKCompany/ShreeHK_BackEnd/routes/outward/outwardRoutes.js):
  - In outward listings (memo, sale, consign, export): add `AND (o.deleted = 0 OR o.deleted IS NULL)`.
  - In `GET /outward/` (by id): add `AND (o.deleted = 0 OR o.deleted IS NULL)` and filter child products `(p.deleted = 0 OR p.deleted IS NULL)`.
  - In `POST /outward/save`: filter `(deleted = 0 OR deleted IS NULL)` when looking up stones to outward.
- [`routes/transaction/transactionStockService.js`](file:///d:/Kishan_Ghodasara_Project/shreeHKCompany/ShreeHK_BackEnd/routes/transaction/transactionStockService.js) (Outward/Hold/GIA/Memo/Return sections):
  - In `listOutwardStock`: filter `AND (o.deleted = 0 OR o.deleted IS NULL)`.
  - In `getOutwardData`: filter `AND (deleted = 0 OR deleted IS NULL)`.
  - In `deleteOutwardStock` & `deleteGia`: soft-delete linked `dai_outward_item` records inside the transaction.
  - In `returnOutwardMemo`, `outwardMemoToSale`, `returnGia`: add `AND (deleted = 0 OR deleted IS NULL)` on lookups.
- [`routes/outward/holdRepository.js`](file:///d:/Kishan_Ghodasara_Project/shreeHKCompany/ShreeHK_BackEnd/routes/outward/holdRepository.js) & [`jobs/holdCron.js`](file:///d:/Kishan_Ghodasara_Project/shreeHKCompany/ShreeHK_BackEnd/jobs/holdCron.js):
  - Ensure hold listings and auto-release crons only query active holds and stones (`deleted = 0 OR deleted IS NULL`).
- [`services/stockMovementService.js`](file:///d:/Kishan_Ghodasara_Project/shreeHKCompany/ShreeHK_BackEnd/services/stockMovementService.js):
  - In `getOutwardItems` and `markOutwardItemReturned`: add `AND (deleted = 0 OR deleted IS NULL)`.

#### 2. Reused Components / Logic
- Existing `helper.runInTransaction`, `getOutwardItems`, `buildUserFilter`, `companyInClause`.
- Strict Rule B compliance: `LEFT JOIN dai_party p` retains historical party name on memos and invoices without filter.

Shall I proceed with implementing and running the test suite for **Sub-part 2(b)**?
thinking:
The test run confirms the endpoint functionality. Verified endpoints include listing inward transactions, retrieving bill details, checking SKU existence, and creating a new inward bill. The successful tests validate the expected behavior for each of these actions.


Verified the soft-delete functionality by confirming the expected changes in database rows.  Validated that the soft-deleted SKU is now available for reuse, demonstrating the system correctly handles deleted items. Completed a regression check against a baseline, confirming the active stock totals remain consistent.
